mathematical_meanings: Left image: x denotes the unknown vertical diagonal length of the diamond. Right image: x denotes the unknown altitude length to the hypotenuse.
Rationales: The left occurrence is located at x beside the vertical double-headed dimension line; the right occurrence is at x beside the interior perpendicular segment. Both use the selected notation for the same unknown-length variable role. This compares the local role, without asserting that the two underlying objects or unknown values are identical.
